# PRD-XX Replace With Title

## Purpose

State why this PRD exists and what product increment, phase, or release it defines.

## Product Summary

Summarize the product surface, capability set, and user value at a high level.

## History and Context

Explain what came before, what decisions or constraints shaped this PRD, and why this phase matters now.

## Problem

Describe the user or business problem this PRD addresses. Focus on pain, not solution details.

## Product Goal

Define the intended outcome of this PRD in product terms. This should explain what success looks like if the release ships well.

## Target Users

List the primary and secondary user groups this PRD is designed for, including the traits that matter for scope decisions.

## Product Principles

Capture the product-level principles or decision rules that should guide tradeoffs across all child FRDs.

## Scope

### In scope

List the major capabilities, journeys, or domains this PRD explicitly includes.

### Out of scope

List important exclusions so adjacent work is not accidentally assumed to be part of this PRD.

## Core User Flows

Describe the most important end-to-end flows this PRD must support. Keep them release-level, not slice-level.

## Release-Level Success Criteria

Define the observable outcomes or validation signals that would indicate this PRD succeeded.

## Risks

List the main product, delivery, adoption, or dependency risks that could threaten the release.

## Linked FRDs

Reference the FRDs that break this PRD into smaller product domains.
